answer: Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the saffron is the pass, the wander is the fare, the fable is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price. A single trial, a single mark: the trial is Flour merchant rye toll milled at the sifting loft, the mark is each rye is a grist count weighed beside the makers mark, and the panel accepts nothing else. Getting caught costs the farm a 50% cut on 39388 POA of stakes, and the panel catches farms most of the time.
